{{Top|leg}}
'''Th'twirirl''' was a [[Ssi-ruu]] who participated in his [[Species/Legends|species]]' foray into [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to find new subjects for [[entechment]]. During this time, he served as [[Unit Commander]] in the [[Ssi-ruuvi Imperium]] when he was attached to the landers that assaulted the planet [[G'rho]]. He was present during the capture of the young [[Dev Sibwarra]] who [[Entechment Chief]] [[Yifaii]] intended to discard. However, Th'twirirl decided instead to pass the [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]] to Yifaii's assistant [[Firwirrung]].
